name: complexity-optimizer
reason: Not Codex-specific by content, but routed there deliberately. hotspot-optimizer already covers algorithmic complexity and performance hotspots for Claude as a claude-core plugin skill, so carrying both in one listing was a duplicate whose descriptions collided. Moving this one to the Codex root gives each harness exactly one complexity lane at zero Claude listing cost, and bounded analysis is a Codex default lane under MODELS.md. This copy exists only to keep it under version control, since the Codex skill root is not a git checkout. This skill was install-only and never tracked in skills/; the path is recorded in the canonical form the archive schema requires.
restore: It is not retired. Edit ~/.codex/skills/complexity-optimizer; refresh this copy when it changes.
